title: Identifying your station
blurb: The big idea before the cards.

lines.caption: Every station must say who it is. Give your call sign at least every ten minutes, and at the end of the contact.
lines.label: who is on the air

lines.caption: A tactical name like Race Headquarters helps at events, but it never replaces your call sign.
lines.label: still your call sign

lines.caption: On voice, say your call sign in English, or send it in Morse code.
lines.label: English, or Morse code

lines.caption: When you pass a message on behalf of someone else, that person is a third party.
lines.label: a third party

lines.caption: A repeater passes your signal on at once, on another channel. If you break a rule through it, you answer for it.
lines.label: you answer for it

lines.caption: A club needs at least four members for its own license. And the FCC may ask to inspect any station at any time.
lines.label: four members
